missable_rule: A trophy counts as missable when it is tied to one named story mission or a single one-off story beat. Story missions can usually be replayed, so a flag means do it when it comes up, not that it is gone for good.

source_legend.advice: This atlas's own advice, read from the official description — not yet checked inside the game
source_legend.official: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list: the official trophy names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them

title: Leonida Trophy Atlas — GTA VI (PS5)

trophies.guide: Earn every other trophy in Leonida. The platinum lands the moment the 54th pops — no separate task of its own.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing. It unlocks as the story moves on — you cannot pass it by.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep following the story and it pops at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only — keep playing and it arrives on its own.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Another story beat: just keep the campaign going.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. The last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. The gold for seeing the story through to its ending.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play it when it appears in the story — mission trophies come from named jobs, not free roam.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. A named story heist: run it when the campaign offers it.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Finish that story mission when it comes up.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. A story mission — take it when the game hands it to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. A story job at the airport: run it when it appears.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation when the story reaches it.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Everything counts: missions, activities, collectibles, exploration. Use the tracker to see what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Jump, drift and near-miss your way there — stunts add up across the whole map, so keep driving loud.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Sample all nine activity types — one try each is enough, no mastery needed.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. Gold every one of the 42 range challenges — steady aim and the right weapon for each lane.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Win a drone race at all 14 spots — learn each course's shortcuts.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Win twenty distinct races across Leonida — vary the events, repeats do not count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Out-fish Cal in his challenge — watch the line tension and reel when it slackens.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Finish any arcade game once — pick the shortest cabinet you find.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Run Andy's last job when the strand reaches it.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand ends with this job — take it when it appears.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's last mission closes his strand.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Finish eight stranger strands — follow the odd characters' markers around the state.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand ends here — run his last job.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's last job closes his strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Find all 18 meditation spots and sit a while at each.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Track down the one animal Bret wants — follow his clues, then take the shot clean.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Finish any three card sets — trade duplicates and check every shop shelf.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Tag 100 spots with WAiNK It — the counter climbs as you travel, so tag everywhere you stop.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Clear fifty challenges of any kind — the tracker shows which are closest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. With your partner beside you, shake a four-star wanted level and get clear — do it while the story still pairs you up.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in a row with your partner and keep the heat — plan the route before the first door.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Spot a hundred different vehicles — drive everything you see and the count grows.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Line up five targets, trigger Combat Focus, and drop them all before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave the airport on your own terms — any unscheduled exit counts.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Deal with the Rhinos — steal one, wreck one, or survive one rolling your way.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get in and out of a jewelry store unseen — quiet entry, no alarms, no witnesses.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Crack five bank vaults and get away clean each time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck and vanish before backup arrives.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state — the map fills in as you go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation for each of the nine gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Order a cocktail on Ocean Beach and take in the view — a quiet story beat, easy to walk past.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive out of a showroom through the glass — style points count, so make it loud.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates alley — follow through on the shot.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A moment with your partner that the whole state notices — it comes once, so be ready when it does.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make the choices the story offers — the count climbs toward 500 across the campaign.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail once, then succeed on the second try — a story beat that only triggers that way.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — keep your eyes open in the odd corners of Leonida.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone flat with a melee drive-by — line the car up and swing as you pass.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Push a quarter-million in marked bills through your contacts — the laundering cut is the cost of clean money.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend a hundred grand in shops — cars, clothes and guns all count toward it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all eight garage properties — they pay off as storage for the collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app — any ten you own.
trophies.name: On the Spot
